#include <iostream>
#include <cstdint>

using namespace std;

const int MOD = 998244353;

long long modexp(long long a, long long power, int mod) {
    if (power == 0) return 1;
    if (power == 1) return a % mod;
    long long small = modexp(a, power / 2, mod);
    long long ans = (small * small) % mod;
    if (power % 2 != 0) {
        ans = (ans * (a % mod)) % mod;
    }
    return ans;
}

int main() {
    int n, m, l, r;
    cin >> n >> m >> l >> r;
    long long total = 1LL * n * m;
    if (total % 2 != 0) {
        long long ans = modexp(r - l + 1, total, MOD);
        cout << ans << endl;
    } else {
        int k = r - l + 1;
        int e = r / 2 - l / 2;
        if (l % 2 == 0) e++;
        int o = k - e;
        long long ans = (modexp(e + o, total, MOD) + modexp(e - o, total, MOD)) % MOD;
        ans = (ans * modexp(2, MOD - 2, MOD)) % MOD;
        cout << ans << endl;
    }
    return 0;
}
